# cdnpro_edge_hostname (Resource)

A CDN Pro edge hostname: the CNAME target that steers client traffic by region and ISP. Every change is provisioned asynchronously; the provider waits for the operation to finish before returning. The hostname itself is the resource ID and cannot be changed in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cdnpro_edge_hostname" "main" {
  edge_hostname = "example.edgesuffix.qtlgslb.com"
  description   = "Edge hostname for example-site"

  client_zones = [
    {
      region = "all"
      isp    = "all"
      weight = 100
      action = {
        type        = "deliver"
        by          = ["standard"]
        enable_ipv6 = true
      }
    }
  ]

  deliver_by_https = {
    state = "on"
    alpn  = "h2,h3"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_zones` (Attributes List) Traffic steering rules. More specific regions take precedence over broader ones. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--client_zones))
- `edge_hostname` (String) The edge hostname, for example `example.edgesuffix.qtlgslb.com`. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `deliver_by_https` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deliver_by_https))
- `description` (String)
- `estimated_bandwidth` (String)
- `force_delete` (Boolean) Send `Check-Usage: no` on destroy, bypassing the API's refusal to delete an edge hostname that served traffic in the last 24 hours.

### Read-Only

- `has_beian` (Boolean) Whether the edge hostname was created with China server groups. Read-only.
- `history` (Attributes List) Provisioning history, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--history))

<a id="nestedatt--client_zones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `client_zones`

Required:

- `action` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--client_zones--action))
- `isp` (String) ISP code, `all`, or a comma-separated list of up to 10 codes.
- `region` (String) Client region code (e.g. `all`, `eu`, `as.cn`) from the client regions API.

Optional:

- `weight` (Number)

<a id="nestedatt--client_zones--action"></a>
### Nested Schema for `client_zones.action`

Required:

- `type` (String)

Optional:

- `by` (Set of String) Server groups for `deliver` actions (e.g. `standard`, `premium`). The API returns a canonical ordering, hence a set.
- `enable_ipv6` (Boolean) Only consulted for `deliver` actions.
- `to` (List of String) Hostnames or IP addresses for `redirect` actions.



<a id="nestedatt--deliver_by_https"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deliver_by_https`

Required:

- `state` (String)

Optional:

- `alpn` (String)
- `port` (Number)
- `ttl` (Number)


<a id="nestedatt--history"></a>
### Nested Schema for `history`

Read-Only:

- `api_account_id` (String)
- `api_name` (String)
- `api_request_id` (String)
- `finish_time` (String)
- `operation` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `status_details` (String)
- `submission_time` (String)
- `time` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# The edge hostname itself is the identifier.
terraform import cdnpro_edge_hostname.main example.edgesuffix.qtlgslb.com
```
